noExistingKind.lock-vs-roll-replay: compounds a RATE series (1 + R·p/1200); here the input is a price INDEX level ratio, and the fixed side grows on anniversaries, not a constant multiple compared once
noExistingKind.fixed-cap-vs-index-growth: quarterly series, a fixed nominal cap vs gain over one buy year; no rolling windows, no fixed growth rate
noExistingKind.retirement-6040: annual stock/bond/inflation returns with withdrawals; no monthly CPI windows
noExistingKind.float-vs-fixed-replay: loan interest on a rate index

newKindNeeds.inputs: one monthly price index CSV (date, value; blank or "." = missing, not 0): CPIAUCNS primary; optional robust indexes (CWUR0000SA0, PCEPI) with the same layout
newKindNeeds.computation: for every start month s >= firstStart and each horizon H (years) with I(s) and I(s+12H) present: P = I(s+12H)/I(s); fixed-raise growth G = (1+raise)^H; kept = G >= P; real fixed-raise check = 100·G/P; real level check = 100/P; annualized inflation = 100(P^(1/H) − 1); per-anniversary path for a named start month: 100·(1+raise)^k / (I(s+12k)/I(s)), k = 0..H
newKindNeeds.outputs: nWindows, first/last start, kept count and share, kept first/last start, median/min/max annualized inflation, median/worst/best real value of fixed-raise and level checks (+ start of worst/best; earliest on ties), shares >= bands (90, 75), latest window values, by start decade (n, kept, median/min/max real, median inflation), raise grid shares, raise needed for half/all windows, guide path and its derived keys, the same headline keys on each robust index
newKindNeeds.invariants: kept share in [0,100]; real fixed-raise > real level in every window when raise > 0; doubling the index leaves every output unchanged; kept count non-decreasing in raise; raise_needed_half = median inflation; raise_needed_all = max inflation and every window kept at that raise; windows skipping a blank month are excluded (2025-10 → start 2005-10 for H=20, 2000-10 for H=25)
newKindNeeds.dataNow: CPIAUCNS last observation 2026-08-01 (pinned coed=2026-08-01, SHA f79e3a78…; September 2026 CPI not released on 2026-10-08)
